scope: VmRSS/HWM and retained counts from actual samples, phase and 15-minute groups. Offsets relative to first sample; active reporting omits first 2 seconds. Older cohort had periodic active samples only; fixed cohort captures recovery/shutdown too. HWM is process-lifetime and Rust resets each generation. No rotation/checkpoint shortcut/retention, no leak or bounded RSS/H4 claim.
